text:
jordan: quick flag  I noticed our replay service captured raw prompt text for a tenant during an incident. the snapshot includes request_body and the replay index points to same s3 prefix as embeddings.
maya: ahh that adjacency is scary. replay snapshots should never carry plaintext alongside vectors. we need a separation policy ASAP.
liam: root cause: replay pipeline copies the request envelope before the scrub hook runs. fix is either move scrub earlier or make the replay copy reference the fingerprint only. leaning to the latter to avoid reordering hazards.
olivia: UX: console should surface a "replay contains raw data" warning on tenant pages and block export until approved. add a per-tenant replay_quota that prevents mass dumps.
raja: sampling implications: if we fingerprint everything but replay keeps full text for sampled requests, storage still grows. propose: sampled_replay_rate = min(global_rate, tenant_rate); and sampled_replay_burst capped at 100/day per tenant.
jordan: suggested policy proposal (short):
- All replay artifacts store only fingerprint: fp:v3:<hex>.
- If raw capture is required, store encrypted blob in audit-vault with 2-approver flow and console reason field.
- Default retention: hosted=30d, enterprise opt-in 365d.
- Sampling: base 0.005 for free, 0.02 for paid, allow emergency increases via signed SSO token.
liam: technical note: implement pre-ingest idempotent hook that rewrites envelope to: `{"fp":"fp:v3:...","meta":{...}}` and emits `audit:event:replay_captured` only when encrypted blob is written. this avoids exposing plaintext to downstream consumers.
maya: access control: any decryption operation must require role=security OR role=tenant-admin AND an approver audit entry. no single-click console unmask. also console should show last 5 access entries.
olivia: dashboard work: add a tile to the tenant dashboard: "replay exposures" (count, last_exposure_ts, storage_bytes) and another for sampling rate with a slider to preview expected monthly storage. that's useful for SRE and finance when negotiating enterprise enclave fees.
raja: quotas: enforce a hard cap on replay artifact creation per-tenant per-day; exceeders go into queued mode and require manual review. set defaults: hosted: 50/day, paid: 500/day, enterprise: configurable.
audit-bot: policy-check: existing replay pipelines scanned. 3 matches where replay copy precedes scrub; flagged.
jordan: action items: liam fix pipeline hook (owner liam, target: 3 biz days), olivia mock dashboard tiles + export block (owner olivia, 1 week), raja implement sampled_replay_rate and caps (owner raja, 2 weeks), maya draft access wording + runbook (owner maya, 48h).
liam: ack. i'll gate the change behind a feature flag and run a staging canary with a small tenant list.
maya: runbook should include immediate steps if raw replay is found: 1) flip feature flag off, 2) rotate ephemeral keys, 3) notify security and tenant, 4) purge or move artifacts to audit-vault.
olivia: i'll add a console banner that shows when a tenant has any archived raw artifacts and disable one-click exports.
raja: don't forget metrics: emit `replay.artifact.created` with tags {tenant, retention_tier, sample_rate} and `replay.artifact.decrypted` with approver ids. we need these to correlate to billing and risk.
jordan: good. prioritize pipeline hook and console blocking. if anyone hits blockers ping security.
audit-bot: nightly-scan scheduled; will re-run after changes.
